format: Tcl-like script with shell commands and comments
description: This file provides a script to enumerate Wi-Fi interfaces and beaconing SSIDs on a device under test. It normalizes whitespace, sorts output, and is designed to work across different hardware variants. Contains comments explaining its purpose and commands for listing interfaces and SSIDs via remote execution.
calls: R "iw dev 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Interface|ssid' | tr -d '\t' | sed 's/[ ]\+/ /g' | sort"
